title: Imaikkaa Nodigal
desc: Anjali Vikramadithyan, a CBI officer, sets out to track down a serial killer who the police claim was killed years ago. However, the investigation becomes personal when the killer targets her family.

title: Sembi
desc: Sembi and her grandmother, Veerathayi, travel in a bus, along with 24 passengers, who strive to help the duo seek justice for the wrongs done to them.

title: Pathu Endrathukulla
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Double Ismart
desc: A dying criminal enlists a rogue scientist to transfer his mind into a savvy street renegade, using a special brain port. Chaos and adventure ensue!

title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

title: Ellam Eli Mayam
desc: Balu goes to a temple on the day of his engagement and insults the deity. As a result, Lord Ganesha sends a mouse to teach him a lesson.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Thaandavam
desc: Kenny Thomas, a visually challenged man, embarks on a killing spree, committing several murders. However, when the police unravel the crime, Kenny's past is revealed.

title: Oru Nodi
desc: When a man goes missing under perplexing circumstances, a police inspector embarks on a quest to investigate the case, exposing a concealed network of political corruption.

title: Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra
desc: A young woman with mystical abilities confronts personal struggles as evil emerges. However, to ensure the safety of the innocent, she must embrace her powers in an ever-changing world.

title: Shakthi Thirumagan
desc: After his mother is mercilessly killed, young Kittu is adopted by an elderly man. As he grows older and is left to look after himself, he resolves to find his mother's killer.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.
